definition.def: If you relax or if something relaxes you, you feel more calm and less worried or tense.
examples: I ought to relax and stop worrying about it. [VERB]
For the first time since his arrival he relaxed slightly. [VERB]
Do something that you know relaxes you. [VERB noun]

definition.def: When a part of your body relaxes, or when you relax it, it becomes less stiff or firm.
examples: Massage is used to relax muscles, relieve stress and improve the circulation. [VERB noun]
His face relaxes into a contented smile. [VERB]

definition.def: If you relax your grip or hold on something, you hold it less tightly than before.
examples: He gradually relaxed his grip on the arms of the chair. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you relax a rule or your control over something, or if it relaxes, it becomes less firm or strong.
examples: Rules governing student conduct relaxed somewhat in recent years. [VERB]
How much can the President relax his grip over the nation? [VERB noun]
Some analysts believe that the government soon will begin relaxing economic controls. [VERB noun]
